name: nih-reporter-mcp
description: Query NIH and other HHS-agency research grant funding via live RePORTER data. 14 goal-oriented tools and 9 audience-tailored prompts (program officer, citizen scientist, and general analyst). Tools: search projects, summarize funding (with opt-in provenance), year-by-year trends, organization profiles (with opt-in provenance), investigator portfolios, investigator overlap/duplication check, study section workload analysis, recent awards tracking, evidence bundle export (inspectable audit trail), plain-language health-topic explanations from MedlinePlus (English/Spanish), publications, direct project lookup, and PubMed citation resolution via NCBI E-utilities, and clinical-trial linkage lookup via ClinicalTrials.gov v2 (NIH-vs-FDA disambiguation, evidence-class classification, interventional/observational distinction).
